{{Quote|I don't think you understand. You killed my brother and now I'm gonna kill your pet.|The Quarren, to Din Djarin|<ref name="Chapter 11" />}}
The '''brother''' of a [[Unidentified Quarren boatman|Quarren boatman]] sought revenge on the [[Mandalorian]] [[Din Djarin]], whom he believed had killed his brother when he went aboard the boatman's since sunken [[boat]] on the [[moon]] [[Trask]]. The [[Quarren]] confronted Djarin at the port with a number of Quarrens and threatened to [[Death|kill]] [[Din Grogu|Grogu]]. However, the boatman's true killers arrived and killed the boatman's brother and his comrades.

==Biography==
{{Quote|He didn't kill your brother. I did.|Bo-Katan Kryze, to the boatman's brother|<ref name="Chapter 11" />}}
In [[9 ABY]],<ref name="Date" /> during the [[New Republic Era|reign]] of the [[New Republic]], the brother of a [[Quarren]] [[Unidentified Quarren boatman|boatman]] was present on the [[Water|estuary]] [[moon]] of [[Trask]]. One [[Standard day|day]], the boatman was [[Death|killed]] while after taking the [[Mandalorian]] [[Din Djarin]] and his [[foundling]]<ref name="Chapter 11" /> [[Din Grogu|Grogu]]<ref name="Chapter 13">{{TheMandalorian|Chapter 13: The Jedi}}</ref> aboard his [[boat]], which sank along with the entire crew. Believing that Djarin had killed the boatman, the boatman's brother, holding a [[spear]], confronted the Mandalorian and Grogu that night at the port, backed by a number of armed Quarren.<ref name="Chapter 11" />

The boatman's brother accused Djarin of killing his the boatman, but the Mandalorian simply asked to for the Quarren to let him pass. The brother, though, ignored Djarin's request and threatened to kill Grogu in revenge. That was when three other Mandalorians flew down on [[jetpack]]s to assist Djarin. The lead Mandalorian, [[Bo-Katan Kryze]], revealed that she had killed the boatman. She and her two comrades then fired on the boatman's brother and his assailants, killing all of them. The Mandalorians departed the scene after.<ref name="Chapter 11" />

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|Hey! You… You killed my brother.|The Quarren confronts Din Djarin|<ref name="Chapter 11" />}}
The Quarren boatman's brother was a Quarren male with [[Color|orange]] skin and blue [[eye]]s. Believing Din Djarin had killed the boatman, he was insistent with the Mandalorian and wished to kill Grogu in revenge.<ref name="Chapter 11" />

==Equipment==
The boatman's brother wore a green [[Jacket|coat]] with a brown [[belt]] and brown trousers and [[boot]]s. He wielded a spear and had white fabric wrapped around his wrists.<ref name="Chapter 11" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Quarren boatman's brother appeared in "[[Chapter 11: The Heiress]]" of [[Jon Favreau]]'s [[Disney+]] series ''[[Star Wars: The Mandalorian]]'', which was directed by [[Bryce Dallas Howard]]<ref name="Chapter 11" /> and released on [[November 13]], [[2020]].<ref name="D23">{{D23|url=everything-new-you-can-stream-on-disney-in-november-2020|text=Everything New You Can Stream on Disney+ in November 2020}}</ref> He was credited as "Quarren" in the subtitles.<ref name="Chapter 11" />
